confidence_notes: I based the restaurant, coffee and beer anchors on two web searches of aggregated cost-of-living estimates, including mylifeelsewhere, nomad.watch and currency-shop spending guides. Those figures put an inexpensive meal at about $2.50-5 (one source says $3.20), a mid-range dinner for two at $15-30, a cappuccino at $1.50-2.50 and a local draft beer at $0.50-1. The figures come from different dates, some as old as mid-2025. Most Siem Reap prices are quoted in USD, so currency conversion is not a concern. Cocktail and wine anchors are model estimates, not search results. I based them on Pub Street happy-hour cocktails at $2-3 rising to about $5 at mid-range bars, and on imported wine being much more expensive than local beer. Wine is the least certain anchor. Accommodation anchors are holistic estimates from general knowledge. I did not check live booking pages. Rates for July 2026, the low or green season, are probably at the cheaper end. The FX figure of 0.6720 USD per AUD on 18 November 2026 is the RBA 4pm rate as reported in my search results. The source URL is the RBA exchange-rates overview page that appeared in those results.
comparable_city_reasoning: Siem Reap is a cheap, tourism-heavy Southeast Asian town where prices are mostly in USD. It compares with Luang Prabang and with cheaper tourist areas in Vietnam such as Hoi An. Drinks are cheaper than in Phnom Penh, and accommodation is plentiful and inexpensive.
